challenge.results: Both full-body digests matched their acquisition envelopes. The eight rows had distinct representation digests. The Jam row uniquely matched the Perforce README digest dd700eae5f1c3587cd1ef1fc820663255ce517018844c93c9950d1acc82f1427 and the claimed edition and passage. limitations: The captured digest fixes the bytes inspected at the mutable Perforce URL. The lifecycle assignment applies to that exact documentary reference.
